items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Two-line change: an existing helper call `self.query.get_initial_alias()` with a short comment, '# Ensure base table is in aliases.' It matches the surrounding style.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Reuses the existing helper inside single_alias and leaves Collector/QuerySet.delete untouched. No duplicated logic, and the temporary test file was deleted.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Minimal root-cause fix with no new error paths or magic constants. get_initial_alias is idempotent, so calling it from the cached_property is safe. Hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52).

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: Fixed in SQLDeleteCompiler.single_alias by registering the base alias before counting, so joined deletes still count >1 alias and keep the subquery. No backend-specific branch, and the MySQL compiler benefits too. Same as the reference fix.
